folds.heading: ## UI core rounds 1-7 application B149, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Scoped review of [UI core rounds 1-7](audits/UI_DESIGN_CORE_AUDIT.md#round-1-2026-10-22), lines 1-441; later rounds remain to be reviewed. Preserve the corrections within that scope rather than reopening the earliest diagnosis: a closed Gear disclosure's hidden content is not lost region space, a dock declaration does not prove automatic center replacement, and screenshots with different disclosures do not establish a width cause. Round 4 replaces universal one-pixel immobility with preservation of the actual task, selected subject, pending choice, work/log access, focus, scroll and return. Deliberately expanded tasks and UR69 may reflow (AD32, AD36, UR41, UR43, UR52, UR69).

Hover/focus preview, explicit selection and commitment remain different operations. A second preview must not overwrite a pending choice or cover its focused controls. The historical empty-slot and title-only blocker findings need their current consumer checked, not a newly invented global layout. Reports filtering must check actually visible rows and preserve occurrence history; a green control-state assertion alone once missed an overriding display rule. General repeat merging and long-play grammar were not delivered by that repair.

The later full native comparison in rounds 5-6 supersedes a sparse shell's fidelity claim while retaining both as dated studies. A successful token/geometry test or matching source hash cannot certify actual font crispness, the installed app, every service or unseen transition. Scaled captures and derived geometry retain their stated limits; decorative tokens require actual consuming styles and a computed-value check where the result is claimed. The old L/UIS/UIV ordering, source reservations, proposed model choices and human taste gates are not fresh runtime dispatch or mandatory approval (AD41, AD42).
